topic: The Physics of Pi: Block Collisions and Transcendental Digits

sections.title: The Hook: Surprising Collisions
lecture_lines: Two blocks collide on a frictionless surface.
A heavy block hits a smaller block.
The smaller block bounces off a wall.
We count every impact between blocks.
The total count reveals mysterious digits.
animations: Create two circles #FF5733 and #33FF57 appearing in center, replacing them with [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/block.svg].
Move the block assets towards each other to collide.
Play an impact animation at the collision point using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/wall.svg] as a debris effect.
Show the blocks rebounding after the collision.
Label the velocity vectors #FFFFFF near each block [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/block.svg].

sections.title: Prerequisite: Conservation Laws
lecture_lines: Conservation of momentum defines the physics.
We visualize this in phase space.
animations: Display the equation for momentum #FFFFFF in center. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/billiard.svg]
Highlight the mass #FFFF00 and velocity #00FFFF terms.
Animate the total momentum conserved during motion. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/billiard.svg]

sections.title: Connecting Physics to Geometry
lecture_lines: Mass ratio defines the wedge angle.
Phase space paths form circular arcs.
Arc length relates to pi digits.
animations: Display a geometry shape [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/wedge.svg] #FFFFFF on the screen.
Animate the transformation of physics states to geometric paths using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/circle.svg].
Highlight the intersection points #FF00FF as meaningful physics data.

sections.title: The Grand Reveal
lecture_lines: Collisions map to digits of pi.
animations: Overlay the geometric visualization #00FF00 on the physics equation.
Flash the combined result #FFFF00 to signify the discovery [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/billiard.svg].
